cues.zh: 没区别。于是我又试了两个充电桩，总共三个，看到的最高是 113

cues.en: kilowatts. I'm only getting a 113 kilowatts.
cues.zh: 千瓦。我只拿到 113 千瓦。

cues.en: I should be getting a 150
cues.zh: 我本应拿到 150

cues.en: and I'm not the best Electrify America.
cues.zh: 可我没有。这可是最好的 Electrify America。

cues.en: Why?
cues.zh: 为什么？

cues.en: I was so sure that I would get full power at this perfect Electrify America that I started doubting the car at this point. As a sanity check after I got back, I went to a nearby three fifty kilowatt EV go to see if my car could still accept a 150 kilowatts. And I went there without using on route battery preconditioning.
cues.zh: 我太确定在这个完美的 Electrify America 能拿到满功率，以至于这时都开始怀疑车了。回来之后，为了验证一下，我去了附近一个 350 千瓦的 EVgo，看看我的车还能不能接受 150 千瓦。而且我去那儿时没有用途中电池预热。

cues.en: And when I got there,
cues.zh: 等我到那儿时，

cues.en: the parking lot was under construction and I couldn't get to them. So I went to a different one. I plugged in at 9% with no preconditioning
cues.zh: 停车场在施工，我过不去。于是我换了一个充电站。我在电量9%时插枪充电，没有做电池预热

cues.en: and got a 155
cues.zh: 充到了155

cues.en: kilowatts
cues.zh: 千瓦

cues.en: all the way to 30%.
cues.zh: 一路充到30%。

cues.en: So yeah, it does look like it was the fault of the chargers there. Not that it matters really. One good charge at the end wouldn't make up for this series of bad charging experience I had for the entire rest of the trip. Is this what the chargers are like everywhere? No, Probably not. This is one region on one day. However, I'd argue that it shouldn't be like this anywhere. The route for this trip was inspired by a recent trip I took down to Florida. The first leg of that trip was the route that I just showed you and I was shocked
cues.zh: 所以是的，看起来确实是那里充电桩的问题。不过其实也不重要了。最后一次好的充电，也弥补不了我在整趟旅程其余时间里经历的这一连串糟糕充电体验。各地的充电桩都这样吗？不，大概不是。这只是某一天、某个地区的情况。不过我认为，任何地方都不该是这样。这次行程的路线，是受我最近去佛罗里达的一趟旅行启发。那趟旅行的第一段，就是我刚给你们看的路线，而我很震惊

cues.en: at how poorly it went. I didn't get a single good charging session until I went 10 miles out of my way to go to the Electrify America at the Volkswagen plant. And yes, when I was there before, I did get the full one fifty kilowatts. I don't know what happened this time. The charging stops on that trip did get better as I made my way down through Georgia and Florida, and some of them were even downright perfect, but that did not make up for the entire first day of bad charging experiences.
cues.zh: 它竟然进行得这么糟。直到我绕路10英里，去了大众工厂的Electrify America，才第一次有了像样的充电体验。是的，我之前去那里时，确实充到了完整的150千瓦。我不知道这次怎么了。那趟旅行中，随着我一路南下穿过佐治亚州和佛罗里达州，充电站确实变好了，有些甚至简直完美，但这仍然弥补不了第一整天糟糕的充电体验。

cues.en: If I was a normal person and not an EV nerd, I would have sold my Polestar after that trip. Again, the vast majority of EV charging is done at home and some people never even use rapid chargers, but the ability to go on trips easily is still a very important part of the whole well rounded car experience.
cues.zh: 如果我是一个普通人，而不是电动车发烧友，那趟旅行之后我就会把Polestar卖掉。再说一次，绝大多数电动车充电都是在家完成的，有些人甚至从来不用快充；但能够轻松地长途出行，仍然是完整全面用车体验中非常重要的一部分。

cues.en: Anyway, that's why access to superchargers is such a big deal. Currently, Electrify America is the only other charging network out there with highway planning and they're unreliable. And most everything else is poorly set up, confusing,
cues.zh: 总之，这就是为什么能用超级充电桩是件大事。目前，Electrify America 是唯一另一个有高速路充电规划的网络，但它们不可靠。其他大多数设施都布置得很差、令人困惑，

cues.en: unreliable,
cues.zh: 不可靠，

cues.en: or just not a good experience. Now, that's not to say the supercharger experience will be perfect with all these non Tesla's using them. There's two big issues of note. They were designed with Tesla's in mind which all have a charge point in the rear left. So with the charge point in any other place on the car, the cable is too short and the charger is in the wrong place. And I think more importantly, superchargers can only output 500 volts. So 800 volt cars to charge at these superchargers have to use an onboard booster to boost that DC voltage to something they can use, which dramatically limits the power. As an example, a Lucid Air can only onboard about 50 kilowatts from one of these superchargers
cues.zh: 或者体验就是不好。不过，这也不是说，所有这些非特斯拉车来用之后，超级充电体验还会完美。有两个大问题值得注意。它们设计时考虑的是特斯拉，而特斯拉车型的充电口都在左后方。所以如果车的充电口在别的位置，线缆就太短，充电桩位置也不对。而且我认为更重要的是，超级充电桩只能输出 500 伏。所以 800 伏车型在这些超级充电桩充电时，必须用车载升压器把直流电压升到可用的水平，这会大幅限制功率。举个例子，Lucid Air 从这类超级充电桩只能以约 50 千瓦充电

cues.en: using its onboard booster. Both of these issues are solved by version four superchargers
cues.zh: 用的就是车载升压器。这两个问题都被第四版超级充电桩解决了

cues.en: which have longer cables and thousand volt capability,
cues.zh: 它们有更长的线缆，支持 1000 伏，

cues.en: but those are only just starting to roll out. Regardless, access to superchargers is still a huge deal, especially to someone like me who travels in their EV a lot. If you wanna see me do this same trip in my Polestar next year when I have access to v three superchargers,
cues.zh: 但这些才刚刚开始铺开。不管怎样，能用超级充电桩仍然是件大事，尤其像我这种经常开电动车跑长途的人。如果你想看我明年能用 V3 超级充电桩时，开我的 Polestar 跑同样的行程，

cues.en: Let me know in the comments below. In addition to supercharger access, the North American EV industry is moving to a much easier to use less bulky connector, which is a good thing
cues.zh: 在下面评论区告诉我。除了能用超级充电桩，北美电动车行业正在转向更易用、更不笨重的连接器，这是好事

cues.en: even though a big transition like that this late in the game is going to be really confusing to a lot of people for a long time and to the inevitable. I could fill up my gas car in five minutes or I could drive 500 miles without refilling in my blah blah blah. Good for you. Just keep on doing that. Nothing stopping you and thanks for watching.
cues.zh: 尽管在这么晚的阶段进行这么大的转变，会让很多人困惑很久，也会听到那些不可避免的话：“我油车五分钟加满，或者我能开 500 英里不加油，我的某某车……” 挺好，你继续。没人拦你。感谢观看。
